diagnostic_evidence.quote: The term containing $F$ is treated in the same manner as the corresponding term in Corollary \ref{CorStrichWave}.
The discrete Duhamel formula \eqref{DiskrDuhamelStrang} and the discrete Strichartz estimate from Corollary \ref{CorDisStrichWave} imply

issues.failure_explanation: As written, the sum defining W_n has no time-step factor \tau, while the right-hand side uses the discrete \ell^1 norm \|F\|_{\ell^1_{\tau,T}L^2} = \tau\sum_k\|F_k\|_{L^2}. For example, take F_0=1 and F_k=0 for k>0. Then the zero-frequency part of w_n is n\tau, whose \ell^6_{\tau,T}L^9 norm is of order 1, whereas the claimed right-hand side is \tau. Thus the inequality fails by a factor 1/\tau. The correct discrete Duhamel term should be \tau\sum_{k=0}^n e^{(n-k)\tau A}(0,F_k), matching the \tau in the \ell^1 norm.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Insert \tau before the sum in the definition of W_n in CorDisStrichWave (and correspondingly in its proof), so that W_n = e^{n\tau A}(f,g) + \tau\sum_{k=0}^n e^{(n-k)\tau A}(0,F_k). This makes the corollary match the discrete Duhamel formula and the \ell^1_{\tau,T}L^2 norm; the dependent results then follow without further changes.
issues.overall_effect: The discrete local wellposedness lemma and the stability estimate for \alpha=4 are not justified as stated, so the \alpha=4 parts of the global error bounds in Theorem \ref{ThmStrang} and Theorem \ref{ThmStrangFully} become unsupported.
issues.title: Missing time-step factor in discrete Strichartz corollary
issues.why_classification: The repair is a single forced insertion of \tau; no new argument, construction, or loss of mathematical content is required, and all advertised results survive.
